name: fal MCP Server
tagline: One hosted endpoint to search, run and chain 1,000+ image, video and audio models.
description: fal's official stateless MCP server gives agents the entire fal platform through nine tools: discover models, search docs, read schemas and pricing, run inference, submit async jobs and upload files. For filmmakers it is the broadest single gateway — Veo, Kling, LTX-2, Hailuo, FLUX, Ideogram, plus audio like Stable Audio 2.5, CassetteAI SFX and Beatoven — behind one connector.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http fal https://mcp.fal.ai/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_FAL_KEY"

auth.key_url: fal.ai dashboard → API Keys (sent as Authorization: Bearer header, never stored server-side)

notes: Hosted and fully stateless; the MCP itself is free, you pay standard fal per-run pricing. There is no OAuth flow — the key rides in an Authorization header, so clients that cannot attach custom headers are out. Arguably the best single 'everything' server for a generative film pipeline, and the practical MCP route to models with no first-party server (LTX-2, Stable Audio, CassetteAI, Beatoven).

name: Krea MCP Server
tagline: Official hosted MCP for Krea image/video models, schemas, uploads, and job widgets.
description: Krea's official Streamable HTTP MCP lets agents discover available image and video models, inspect live input schemas, submit generation jobs, upload local assets, poll results, and cancel mistakes. For filmmakers it is a clean direct route into Krea's creative API and model shelf without hard-coding endpoints that drift. The MCP Apps widget can show an inline generation tile, auto-poll job progress, retry, cancel, and compare enhancement results in clients that support it.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add --transport http krea-ai https://api.krea.ai/mcp

auth.key_url: OAuth browser flow; API-token fallback from https://www.krea.ai/app/api/tokens sent as Authorization: Bearer.

notes: Official hosted Streamable HTTP, endpoint answering as of Aug 11 2026. OAuth was added Jun 13 2026 and bills the workspace selected during consent; API-token auth still works for clients without OAuth but bills a separate workspace API balance. Provider models do disappear: video/openai/sora-2 and video/bytedance/seedance-1.0-lite were sunset Apr 27 2026 and image/bytedance/seedream-3 on May 13 2026, and a sunset endpoint returns a terminal 410. Have the agent call list_models/get_model_schema first — Krea surfaces deprecation metadata there, and the live shelf now runs Krea 2, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0/o3, Runway Gen-4.5, Seedance 2.x, Seedream 5 and LTX-2. get_upload_url returns presigned upload URLs valid for three hours. Docs moved from docs.krea.ai to www.krea.ai/docs.

name: Replicate MCP Server
tagline: Official remote MCP for discovering and running thousands of models on Replicate.
description: Replicate's official MCP server (remote, plus a self-hostable npm package generated from their HTTP API) lets agents search, compare and run any Replicate model — Veo, Kling, Wan, FLUX, SDXL, LTX and more. Experimental 'code mode' lets the model write sandboxed TypeScript against the Replicate SDK for faster multi-step chains.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add replicate https://mcp.replicate.com/sse --transport sse --scope user

auth.key_url: https://replicate.com/account/api-tokens (the remote server runs an OAuth flow and stores the token on your behalf)

notes: Remote SSE endpoint at mcp.replicate.com/sse is live and OAuth-gated (WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="OAuth"); mcp.replicate.com/mcp answers the same way, but /sse is what the docs still publish. Caveat: Replicate's docs call the npm package 'automatically updated', yet replicate-mcp@latest is still 0.9.0 from Jun 2025 and the only recent publishes are 2.0.0-alpha, last cut Dec 18 2025 — code mode wants `npx -y replicate-mcp@alpha --tools=code`. The code-mode repo has not been touched since Nov 2025. Prefer the remote server. Also a strong route to upscalers (Real-ESRGAN, Topaz-style models) with no first-party MCP. Tool names are generated from the HTTP API surface (models.search, predictions.create) rather than a fixed published list.

name: RunAPI MCP Server
tagline: Browse, price, and run 130+ image, video, audio and voice models through one MCP.
description: RunAPI's official MCP server gives agents catalog discovery, input-schema inspection, prompt search, pricing lookup, media task creation, polling and balance checks across its model marketplace. It now ships in two forms: a hosted remote at mcp.runapi.ai and the local stdio npm package. For filmmakers it is a pragmatic aggregator for Flux, Kling, Seedance, Veo, Suno, ElevenLabs and related media endpoints when you want the agent to pick a model from current constraints instead of memorized slugs.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add runapi -s user -- npx -y @runapi.ai/mcp

auth.key_url: https://runapi.ai/mcp (hosted remote takes OAuth or an API key as bearer; the local package adds a browser `login` tool that writes ~/.config/runapi/config.json)

notes: Apache-2.0, npm @runapi.ai/mcp 0.9.0 published Aug 10 2026, Node >=22, 54 stars. The hosted remote at https://mcp.runapi.ai/mcp answers and is auth-gated (401 without a token); it exposes the eight business tools, while `login` stays local-only. Discovery tools run without a key because the catalog is embedded at build time, so slugs and input constraints go stale between releases — pricing is fetched live, the catalog is not. Narrow sibling: @runapi.ai/runway-aleph-mcp wraps only Runway Aleph.

name: Runware MCP
tagline: Official Runware MCP for image, video, audio, 3D, upscaling, and model search.
description: Runware's official npm MCP package gives agents access to the Runware API: image generation, video generation, audio generation, 3D, upscaling, background removal, captioning, model discovery, pricing, task lookup, and account balance. It also searches the community catalog, so an agent can pull a Civitai fine-tune or a custom upload into a shot. For filmmaker-agents it is a broad media workbench, especially useful when a prompt needs model search plus schema validation before spending credits.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add runware -e RUNWARE_API_KEY=YOUR_KEY -- npx -y @runware/mcp

notes: MIT, npm @runware/mcp 1.3.4 published Jul 31 2026, Node >=18; README documents Claude Desktop, Cursor and Codex stdio configs. The canonical repo is now github.com/Runware/mcp — the older Runware/MCP-Runware was archived Oct 2025 and should not be used. It is a local stdio package, not a hosted remote MCP, and the repo carries almost no stars, so treat the package registry rather than GitHub activity as the health signal.

name: Kie.ai MCP Server
tagline: Run Veo, Seedance, Kling, Runway, Suno, ElevenLabs, FLUX and more through one local MCP.
description: Community MCP server and sibling CLI for Kie.ai's media API, covering image, video, music and speech models from one connector. It is useful for filmmaker-agents that need a broad current model shelf, async task polling, and token-conscious tool loading by category or explicit tool list. The agent still has to treat it as an aggregator, not as first-party access to every underlying model.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add kie-ai -e KIE_AI_API_KEY=YOUR_KEY -- npx -y @felores/kie-ai-mcp-server

notes: MIT, npm @felores/kie-ai-mcp-server 3.6.0, Node >=18, pushed Jul 23 2026, 54 stars. Stdio by default; it can also run as a self-hosted Streamable HTTP service (Dockerfile plus Coolify compose) if you want one shared instance, and there is a zero-context CLI sibling, @felores/kie-cli. It can load all tools, but the README recommends KIE_AI_ENABLED_TOOLS or KIE_AI_TOOL_CATEGORIES=image,video to avoid burning context on unused schemas. Caveat: Kie.ai is an aggregator/reseller path for models from many vendors; rights, availability and ToS safety depend on the underlying provider, and Midjourney/Suno-style access should be treated as gray until verified for your use case.

name: Promptibus MCP
tagline: Model intelligence MCP for prompt syntax, pricing, and budget-aware picks.
description: Promptibus does not generate media; it gives agents current model profiles, pricing, parameters, prompt linting, and prompt optimization for image, video, audio, text, and code models. For filmmaker-agents spending across Runway, Sora, Veo, FLUX, Suno, Midjourney-style tools, and other fast-moving model families, it is a preflight layer that reduces stale syntax and expensive wrong-model choices.
notes: MIT, npm @promptibus/mcp 0.9.0. The hosted endpoint answers tools/list unauthenticated and returns the same seven tools listed here. Caveats: it is a catalogue/preflight server, not a generation router, and it has had no npm release or commit since May 11 2026 with only 3 stars — a model-intelligence service that stops updating is worse than no model-intelligence service, so spot-check anything it tells you about a 2026 model. Anonymous mode works without a key but is capped at 25 requests/day and 10 free-tier models.

name: ComfyUI MCP
tagline: Drive a local ComfyUI: 40+ tools for image, video, audio and 3D workflows.
description: Connects agents to a local or remote ComfyUI instance with 40+ tools for running, validating, composing and managing node workflows, plus 70+ bundled example workflows (FLUX, SDXL, SD3.5, ControlNet, LTX-Video, Mochi, AnimateDiff, Stable Audio). The free/local route for filmmakers who own GPUs and want full pipeline control, including open video models.

install.claude_code: claude mcp add comfyui --transport stdio -- docker run -i --rm --pull always -e COMFYUI_URL=http://host.docker.internal:8000 ghcr.io/shawnrushefsky/comfyui-mcp:latest

auth.key_url: Points at your own ComfyUI instance — port 8000 for the Desktop app, 8188 for a manual install — no cloud account needed

notes: MIT; still the most comprehensive ComfyUI MCP, and the ghcr.io/shawnrushefsky/comfyui-mcp:latest image is published. Caveat: the repo has had no commits since Jan 28 2026 at 18 stars, so newer ComfyUI node packs may outrun its bundled workflows. On Linux swap host.docker.internal for --network=host. Notable alternatives: artokun/comfyui-mcp (Claude Code plugin with slash commands/skills) and joenorton/comfyui-mcp-server (lightweight Python). Requires you to run ComfyUI yourself.

name: PiAPI MCP Server
tagline: Midjourney in an agent — plus Kling, Luma, Hailuo, Hunyuan, Wan, Suno via PiAPI.
description: TypeScript MCP server over PiAPI's unified API, best known as the practical Midjourney route since Midjourney has no public API or official MCP. Also covers FLUX, Kling video and effects, Luma Dream Machine, Hailuo, Hunyuan/Skyreels/Wan video, Trellis 3D, MMAudio scoring and Suno music. Since Jul 2026 it also generates a contract-backed tool for every committed PiAPI (model, task_type) pair, so the exposed surface tracks the upstream catalog instead of only the hand-written convenience tools.

install.stdio_command: Multi-step: git clone https://github.com/apinetwork/piapi-mcp-server, npm install, npm run build, then point your client at node /absolute/path/to/dist/index.js with PIAPI_API_KEY in env. Node 16+.

notes: MIT, 73 stars, actively maintained — catalog refreshed Aug 10 2026 by a drift detector that diffs PiAPI's contract. There is no published npm package: install is clone plus npm run build, or the Smithery installer for Claude Desktop. Caveats: unofficial Midjourney access is a ToS gray area and only `imagine` is implemented, and long video jobs can exceed MCP client timeouts — raise them. Hosted Midjourney alternative: AceDataCloud/MidjourneyMCP.
